question: What portion of items offered to Kālī must the practitioner consume?
premises: Items may be offered to Kālī.
Any such offered item has a portion designated for the practitioner.
Ritual instruction prescribes consuming that portion.
inference: Therefore, the practitioner should eat a portion of whatever has been offered to Kālī.
uncertainties: The exact size or nature of the portion (aṃśa) is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: O Śivā, whatever is offered to Kālī, one should eat a portion of that.
